In this [NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN comparison 2026, we break down the latest features, speeds, security, and pricing to help you decide which VPN suits your needs.

## Overview
Both NordVPN and ExpressVPN remain top contenders in the VPN market as of 2026. They each offer robust security, extensive server networks, and user‑friendly apps across desktop, mobile, and streaming devices. While NordVPN leans heavily on advanced privacy tools like Double VPN and obfuscated servers, ExpressVPN emphasizes raw speed and a consistently reliable connection for streaming and gaming. Understanding where each service excels will let you pick the one that aligns with your priorities.

## Speed and Performance
### Server Network
NordVPN operates over 5,500 servers in 60+ countries, with a growing presence in Africa and South America. ExpressVPN maintains a slightly smaller network of roughly 3,200 servers spread across 94 countries, but it places a higher proportion of servers in premium locations such as the US, UK, Japan, and Australia. Both providers regularly add new locations to reduce latency.

### Connection Speeds
Independent speed tests from early 2026 show ExpressVPN averaging a 5‑10 % edge in download speeds on long‑haul connections, thanks to its proprietary Lightway protocol optimized for low overhead. NordVPN’s NordLynx (based on WireGuard) delivers comparable speeds on short‑to‑medium routes and often outperforms ExpressVPN when connecting to nearby servers. For most users, the difference is negligible; both services easily handle 4K streaming and low‑latency gaming.

## Security and Privacy
### Encryption Standards
Both VPNs use AES‑256 encryption paired with SHA‑256 authentication. NordVPN offers the option to enable Double VPN, routing traffic through two servers for added encryption layers. ExpressVPN relies on its TrustedServer technology, which runs servers on volatile memory (RAM) to ensure no data is written to disk.

### No‑Logs Policy
NordVPN’s no‑logs claim has been audited twice by PwC (2023 and 2025), confirming that connection timestamps, bandwidth usage, and IP addresses are not stored. ExpressVPN underwent a similar audit by KPMG in 2024, with identical results. Both companies are based in privacy‑friendly jurisdictions—NordVPN in Panama and ExpressVPN in the British Virgin Islands—outside the reach of major surveillance alliances.

### Extra Features
NordVPN includes CyberSec (ad‑and‑malware blocker), Dark Web Monitor, and a built‑in password manager (NordPass) in higher tiers. ExpressVPN offers a threat manager that blocks trackers and malicious sites, plus a split‑tunneling feature that lets you route specific apps outside the VPN. Both provide kill switches and DNS leak protection.
